Names the engines judged and the silent ones (`silentEngines`: their counts read 0 because nothing arrives). Status: From Prometheus, over the engines in scope: unknown when none of them reports metrics; critical only while a severity=critical alert fires for them (fleet-wide also an engine-less CibSeven* alert); degraded with any such firing alert, failed job, open incident or an engine in scope that reports nothing; else healthy. description: Compare process KPIs of two periods: A is the baseline, B the candidate (around a deployment, A ends and B starts at its timestamp from camunda7_get_deployment). Periods are clamped to now and the 30-day retention and reported as measured (`partial`); a reversed or wholly out-of-range period is refused. Flagged `suppressed` when either period has fewer than minBucketSize started or completed instances.

totalCount.description: Total number of results matching the filters

description: Resolve a custom incident by ID. The engine refuses failedJob/failedExternalTask (400) — retry those: camunda7_set_job_retries / camunda7_set_external_task_retries on the incident's configuration id.
name: camunda7_resolve_incident

description: Set the retries of an external task. Retries > 0 hand a failed task back to its workers and clear its failedExternalTask incident (camunda7_resolve_incident cannot resolve that incident type); 0 raises an incident. Never locks, completes or fails the task itself.

retries.description: Number of retries to set; > 0 makes a failed task available to its workers again

name: camunda7_set_external_task_retries

description: Set the number of retries for a failed job. Setting retries > 0 will re-execute the job.
name: camunda7_set_job_retries

description: Queue a batch that sets retries on multiple jobs. Returns { batchId, status: "queued" } — not the outcome: follow it with camunda7_get_batch.

dueDate.description: New due date; a past one runs the jobs at once (ISO 8601: date, or date-time with offset)

jobIds.description: IDs of the jobs whose retries should be set.

retries.description: Number of retries to set on every job. Must be >= 0.

name: camunda7_set_job_retries_batch

description: Set the suspension state of a process instance. suspended=true suspends it (jobs, timers, and message correlations are frozen); suspended=false activates (unsuspends) it again.

processInstanceId.description: The ID of the process instance whose suspension state to change.

suspended.description: Target suspension state: `true` suspends the instance (running jobs are frozen), `false` activates (unsuspends) it.

name: camunda7_set_process_instance_suspension

description: Set a single variable on a process instance. An Object needs valueInfo.objectTypeName (pass back the valueInfo read). Never write back a value read with truncated: true — it is incomplete; read it whole first (variableName).

type.description: Variable type (String, Long, Boolean, Date: ISO 8601, Json, Object, …)

value.description: The value (Json/Object: serialized string or parsed JSON)

name: camunda7_set_process_instance_variable

description: Set the assignee of a user task.

userId.description: The user ID to set as assignee

name: camunda7_set_task_assignee

description: Start a new process instance by process definition key. Optionally set a business key and initial variables.

processDefinitionKey.description: The key of the process definition to start

type.description: Variable type (String, Long, Boolean, Date: ISO 8601, Json, Object, …)

name: camunda7_start_process_instance

description: Throw a signal — an ENGINE-WIDE broadcast, not a targeted call: it triggers every matching signal catch event in every running process instance and starts a new instance through every matching signal start event. Cannot be undone or scoped to one instance (use camunda7_correlate_message for targeted delivery).

type.description: Variable type (String, Long, Boolean, Date: ISO 8601, Json, Object, …)

name: camunda7_throw_signal

description: Unclaim (release) a user task, removing the current assignee.
name: camunda7_unclaim_task

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI): which engine write actions the widgets may offer in this deployment.
name: camunda7_widget_actions_data
title: Widget actions (internal)
